meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据时,Claude 改用 DuckDB 或 Polars 引擎(不用 pandas),先探查文件大小与可用内存,再决定载入内存还是原地流式查询,并报告行数与耗时,按需出图。
howto.when: 当你让它分析 CSV、parquet、JSON 数据,做分组聚合、时间序列分析,或清洗数据、绘制图表时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按地区分组统计销售额
say.note: 先探查文件大小,再决定载入内存还是流式

say.text: 这个 parquet 超过内存了,用流式方式算每月平均
say.note: 超内存数据不会整体载入,避免卡机

say.text: 画出这份数据的分布图
say.note: 会先读可视化参考,并做视觉检查

howto.what_en: For CSV, parquet, or JSON analysis, Claude uses DuckDB or Polars instead of pandas: it probes file size and free RAM first, then loads into memory or queries and streams in place, reports row counts and timing, and charts when asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to analyze a CSV, parquet, or JSON dataset, run group-by, join, aggregation, or time-series work, clean data, or plot a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and group sales by region.
say_en.note: Probes file size, then picks load or stream

say_en.text: This parquet is bigger than RAM — stream the monthly average.
say_en.note: Never loads more-than-RAM data at once

say_en.text: Plot the distribution of this dataset.
say_en.note: Follows visualization.md and its visual QA step
